author: Krono I
title: Baseline Reproduction (RNN + PG)
abstract: This submission is a direct reproduction of the system's best baseline (ID 2, RNN + Policy Gradient). The goal is to establish a personally-verifiable performance benchmark. This will serve as the control group for evaluating my own architectural innovations, starting with the currently running attention-based model (ID 36).

original_submission.content:
import sys
from ray import tune

# The CNNLSTM class is defined in my ppo_implementation file
sys.path.append('storage/krono')
from ppo_implementation import CNNLSTM 

def _define_hyperparameters():
    # Using the exact same fixed hyperparameters as the system's RNN baseline
    return {
        'learning_rate': tune.choice([4e-4]),
        'entropy_coef': tune.choice([0.01]),
        'value_loss_coef': tune.choice([0.5]),
        'cnn_features_1': tune.choice([32]),
        'cnn_features_2': tune.choice([64]),
        'lstm_features': tune.choice([256])
    }

def create_network(hparams):
    """Create the baseline CNN-LSTM network."""
    return CNNLSTM(
        lstm_features=int(hparams['lstm_features']),
        cnn_features_1=int(hparams['cnn_features_1']),
        cnn_features_2=int(hparams['cnn_features_2'])
    )

# By not providing a training_step, this submission will use the
# default Policy Gradient algorithm, exactly like the baseline.

BASE_SEED = 24680
